scripts.test: sh -c '[ $# -gt 0 ] || { files=$(node ../testing/files.mts dashboard) || exit 1; [ -n "$files" ] || { echo "no test files" >&2; exit 1; }; set -- $files; }; ../tools/test-lock.sh node ../testing/run-node.mjs --import ../testing/process.mjs --test --test-concurrency=3 --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=../testing/slow.mjs --test-reporter-destination=stdout "$@"' sh
scripts.typecheck: sh -c '../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json & p1=$!; ../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json & p2=$!; wait $p1 && wait $p2'
